data.one_liner: Finds the intrinsic size of a widget and provides it in a convenient builder.
data.what_it_does: Finds the intrinsic size of a widget prior to adding it fully to the widget tree and provides it in a builder function. It renders the subject with zero opacity for one frame to calculate dimensions, then displays the real widget.
use_when: You need to know a widget's intrinsic size before or during layout construction
Building a SliverAppBar with a dynamically sized flexible space or bottom
avoid_when: You cannot tolerate a single-frame transparent measurement phase without a fallback loading state
Standard layout primitives like IntrinsicWidth or IntrinsicHeight already solve your layout constraints
strengths: Convenient builder pattern for intrinsic size measurement
Supports refreshing sizes when subject dimensions change
Allows specifying a first-frame widget to avoid visual glitches
weaknesses: Requires a 1-frame layout pass with zero opacity which can cause a visual glitch if not handled
Requires manual refresh calls when the subject changes size
